ctx.prec=512;a=arb
def bell(xs,n,k):
 if n==0:return a(int(k==0))
 if k==0:return a(0)
 return sum((comb(n-1,j-1)*xs[j-1]*bell(xs,n-j,k-1) for j in range(1,n-k+2)),a(0))
s=a('1.4');dmax=a('1.001');L=a('1.400000000001')
theta=[a(1)]+[a(factorial(21)//factorial(21-k)*2**(k-1)*10**k) for k in range(1,6)]
oz=[s*sum((comb(j-1,k)*theta[k]*dmax**k*factorial(j-1-k) for k in range(j)),a(0)) for j in range(1,7)]
zj=list(map(a,['1.001','2','4.51','16.6','72','400']))

ej=[sum((bell(oj,j,k) for k in range(1,j+1)),a(0)) for j in range(1,7)]
R=a(1)/400;moment=a('.002671854');coef=2*a.pi()*moment/720
p0=coef*ej[5]+a('.5')*ej[3]
